mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k, or Rank IC drops below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.0% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%, or Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and residential investment signals weakening consumer demand and reduced confidence in durable goods spending, which forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 95% of its 2017 baseline indicates a supply-side shock or manufacturing slowdown, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.4% combined with rising payroll growth signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both conditions are met, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 2.5% per annum, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressure that may trigger future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 1.5% annualized, combined with falling industrial production, signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 falls below 1.5% annualized and INDPRO declines, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
